summary: Monday's rebound traced to one headline: Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO triggered a massive relief rally, and the S&P 500 rose +4.73% to 7,237.17, also its best day since April 2025, while the broader market had just closed another brutal session... growing concerns surrounding the AI sector continued to dominate investor sentiment days earlier.
tweet: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO sparked an AI relief rally, lifting the S&P 500 4.73% out of correction while gold and crypto stayed stuck in fear.
